page.notes: Printed page 175; running head "Carolum Rupifortem." Text is set in roman with long s rendered as plain s. The word "Sed" at the foot is a catchword. Some words near the line ends are uncertain, notably "fumplerunt" and "fuum" (possibly "suum"), and "fe fubjicere" (possibly "se subjicere"); the printed form is kept as it appears.
